_doc: Cenas da história de Moisés: recorte do roteiro visual docs/arte/moises-roteiro.webp (x, y, largura na arte reduzida a 1200 px de largura; altura = largura*9/16). 'arte'/'arteAltura' = versão 1200x900 em public/ para a cena parada; 'arteOriginal' = fonte do recorte enviado ao Kling (scripts/fal_cenas.py). Se existir docs/arte/moises/<cena>.png (quadro 16:9 em alta, ver docs/historias-biblicas.md), ele substitui o recorte. Vídeos prontos vão em public/cenas/<cena>.mp4.

moises-1-egito.prompt: A Hebrew family in ancient Egypt: the bearded father carrying heavy stones looks up worried, the mother in a white veil hugs her little curly haired son tightly; behind them the Pharaoh points sternly while guards stand on the brick walls; slow push-in, gentle and child-friendly, no violence

moises-2-cesto.prompt: Young Miriam with long curly hair gently places baby Moses in a woven basket among the tall reeds of the Nile; the baby giggles and kicks his little feet, the reeds sway in the breeze and the water ripples sparkle in the sun

moises-3-princesa.prompt: The Egyptian princess in gold jewelry kneels by the basket and smiles tenderly at baby Moses, who reaches up to her and laughs; her servants watch behind her, palm trees and a temple across the river, soft morning light

moises-4-chamado.prompt: Adult Moses holding his wooden staff looks up in awe at the burning bush in the desert; golden flames dance on the bush without burning it, his blue cloak and curly hair move in the warm wind, he slowly raises his open hand

moises-5-farao.prompt: In the Egyptian palace, Moses with his staff speaks firmly and calmly to the Pharaoh, gesturing with an open hand; the Pharaoh crosses his arms and turns his head proudly; guards stand still in the background, torchlight flickers

moises-6-mar.prompt: Moses raises his staff high and the sea parts into two towering walls of blue water, spray and sunlight pouring down the middle, the huge crowd watches in wonder; epic slow camera push forward

moises-7-travessia.prompt: The happy crowd walks across the dry seabed between the walls of water; a boy and a girl run laughing hand in hand toward the camera, Moses leads the people with his staff raised, families smiling

moises-8-miria.prompt: Miriam dances joyfully shaking her tambourine with colorful ribbons flying, children and women dance and clap around her, palm trees, festive celebration full of music and laughter
